text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of more than the recommended dose of sodium picosulfate, magnesium oxide and anhydrous citric acid may lead to severe electrolyte disturbances, as well as dehydration and hypovolemia, with signs and symptoms of these disturbances [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )]. Monitor for fluid and electrolyte disturbances and treat symptomatically.
